fields.label: Description
fields.value: Photograph caption dated May 30, 1957 reads "Winners in poster contest, sponsored by Las Patroncitas Guild of Valley Presbyterian Hospital, display posters which will be on exhibit at Sports Carnival in Devonshire Downs June 2. From left are Dale Runyan, judge; Douglas Ward, Sparkie Smith, holding Karen Wilson's poster; Don Fontine, Mrs. Kay Bogendorfer, judge; Richard Davis, Richard Heimanson, Polk Riley, and Sam Pritikin, judge." The hospital, in the background, is at 15107 Vanowen Street in Van Nuys.
